title: Companion review sequence preserves model, effort and mode
description: ADR-063 native configuration proof. Setup the private fixture gateway with backlog-review-proof.mjs setup and connect the Companion with backlog-review-connect. Configure two review rows by user input, assert missing-lineage WARM refusal, explicitly choose COLD, then verify persisted choices through backlog.list. Edit and reopen a seeded configuration to verify WARM provenance round-trip. This recipe does not launch or prove a retained reviewer session. Run cleanup afterwards.
